feed.title: NPR Topics: Health
feed.subtitle: Comprehensive health news from NPR. Follow for updates on medical research, wellness trends, public health policy, patient care and healthcare systems.

entry.title: What people aged 50 and older need to know about flu shots
entry.summary: NPR's Ayesha Rascoe asks Dr. Ann Falsey of the University of Rochester Medical School about flu shots for people aged 50 and older.

entry.title: The College of Magic turns ordinary kids into confident, top-hat wearing magicians
entry.summary: The students, many from marginalized communities, learn to conjure up candy, do card tricks — and face the world with a confident, creative and resilient mindset.

entry.title: More dads taking paid family leave for a new baby, sometimes as much as moms are
entry.summary: The U.S. has no national law for paid parental leave. But in states that do, more dads are using the benefit, sometimes more than moms. The change comes as Americans say having kids is unaffordable.

entry.title: Is your Medicare Advantage plan ending next year? Here's what to know
entry.summary: Medicare open enrollment runs through Dec. 7, and for as many as 5 million seniors, it will be important to log on and pick a new plan.

entry.title: Will a macaque eat a grape sitting on a pile of poo? A study on germophobia
entry.summary: When an outbreak strikes, humans try to avoid germs. (Remember wiping off groceries at the start of the pandemic?) What about ... monkeys?

entry.title: Authorities investigating whether first Kenya and Nigeria Ebola cases crossed paths
entry.summary: Nigeria this week recorded its first case of Ebola in the current outbreak, which has spread from the epicenter in Congo to several other African countries.

entry.title: Why going on a 'say no' retreat is a gift to your future self
entry.summary: It's a day to think about all the upcoming appointments and commitments you're dreading — and then decline some of them. Writer Caroline Sylge shares a suggested schedule for the day.

entry.title: Achy from sitting at a desk all day? Try doing this
entry.summary: Sitting at a desk all day hurts. And it isn't good for us. Strategies to make it a little more comfortable, from eye muscle exercises to alleviate eye strain to a back pain-fighting body movement.

entry.title: A GOP congressman voted to cut Medicaid. It covers 62% of his district. Can he win?
entry.summary: Republican U.S. Rep. David Valadao is fighting for reelection in central California. 6 in 10 residents of his district are covered by Medicaid, which he voted to cut last year.

entry.title: High health costs squeeze workers, even if you have good insurance through a job
entry.summary: About 157 million Americans get their health insurance through work. A survey of employers shows a moderate price uptick this year, but workers still say health costs are a top concern.
